notes.title: Update v1.6
notes.content:
Localisation:

 simplified Chinese


Bug Fixes:

 Adressed an issue with the macOS build that would keep the game from launching

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.content:
Halloween Event

The Halloween biome returns in 2023! Running from October 13th till November 13th and giving you access to 6 Halloween themed levels.

The difficulty of the levels is designed to be medium to hard and roughly comparable to levels from the later three biomes of the main game.

The levels will be available from the Halloween event screen that has been added to the game menu.

notes.title: Update v1.5
notes.content:
No major changes, but we've added translations for

 Turkish, and
 Dutch

and improved the readability of the font used for headers.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.4
notes.content:
With our latest update to v1.3 there were a couple of bugs that didn't occur in the development environment. This hotfix addresses these issues.

Bug Fixes:

 fixed an issue that kept the achievement fix from working for players with save games that had already qualified for an achievement
 fixed an issue that kept the Halloween event content from being displayed for the intended duration
 fixed a visual glitch for the onDeath effect in one level

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.content:
Halloween Event
With this update we have added a Halloween biome that will run from October 13th till November 13th and give you access to 6 brand new levels.

The difficulty of the levels is designed to be medium to hard and roughly comparable to levels from the later three biomes of the main game.

The new levels will be available from the Halloween event screen that has been added to the game menu.

Patchnotes Version 1.3

 fixed a bug that blocked some achievements from being granted
 fixed a bug that could cause problems when the snapshot mechanic was used while standing on a self moving trigger plate
 fixed a set of bugs that caused the pushblock from the nightsky biome to behave in unintended ways in very specific circumstances
 fixed a few level specific bugs
 improved hover feedback for buttons and other interactive UI elements

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
new Features:

Using any touch input now hides the cursor. Moving the mouse unhides it again. This change is aimed at making the gameplay experience with the Steam Deck (as well as any other touch screen driven device) more enjoyable.


Bug Fixes:

fixed a bug where changing from windowed mode back to full screen mode would display the wrong viewport resolution
fixed a bug that caused the game (including the audio) to pause on losing focus
fixed a couple of minor bugs within the level architecture

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
New Features:

 added hotkeys to abilities (q,w), undo (e), redo (r), reset (t) and camera rotation (a,d, arrow keys)
 added a toggle to disable fullscreen mode
 added a toggle to enable displaying level names
 displaying current version of the game in credits screen


Bug Fixes:

 the last biome didn't always unlock correctly
 the snapshot ability was available in a level where it was not supposed to be used
 the first achievement was not always registered correctly
